issues.detail: Artifact T10 is mandatory for thread TH5 according to the blueprint, but it is never referenced in the artifact_refs of any message in that thread.
The forbidden term 'performance' is explicitly used in the text of message M19 ('potential performance bottleneck').
The word 'low' is used as an attribute label in message M5 ('low analytics maturity'), violating the anti-leakage rule against using high/medium/low for attributes.

The Product Manager (22473) displays a lack of basic product understanding (e.g., asking 'So should we stop the product?' in M71 after receiving positive feedback), which is inconsistent with their role and trajectory.
